authority_rule: Original private Drive PDF + independently authenticated native ETABS/geotechnical sources govern; journal and synthetic numerics do not constitute design truth
drive_inventory_scope: Connected Drive exact .edb/.e2k name filters and prior G15 source folder, checked 2026-10-24. Other-project models not admissible.
source_F3_status: NOT SAFE IN ONE WAY SHEAR

gates.evidence_needed: Native EDB/E2K for this specific G+1.5 building, independently documented SHA256, identity and version
gates.acceptance_test: Authenticated source ID+SHA-256, owner attestation; Gate19 import clean; never use other-project E2K

gates.evidence_needed: Object-level joint, frame, section and story assignments; relate 23 source column candidates to actual native ETABS IDs
gates.acceptance_test: All members have verifiable story/grid foreign keys, dimensions and source object IDs, no inferred connectors

gates.evidence_needed: ETABS slab polygon vertices, slab offsets/openings, stair/terrace geometry, diaphragm assignment and load directions
gates.acceptance_test: Polygons closed/non-self intersecting, area provenance and elevation match model/export; not report captions/hulls

gates.evidence_needed: Native concrete material property records resolve reported 20 vs 25 kN/m³ and source construction material grades
gates.acceptance_test: Native verified material densities and assignments reconcile inconsistent executive summary and source Table 1

gates.evidence_needed: ETABS line/area wall load objects, rate, story, span, overlapping partition allowance and omitted openings
gates.acceptance_test: Complete source wall path and load-pattern foreign keys; distinguish 9.24,4.47,2.10 kN/m rates from actual segments

gates.evidence_needed: Slab surface assigned selfweight, finishes, partition, terrace and live loads with exact load patterns
gates.acceptance_test: Every area object has unambiguous load class and footprint; 120 vs 125 mm schedule conflict reconciled

gates.evidence_needed: Legally authorized ground occupancy and imposed load classification versus report summary Residential
gates.acceptance_test: Document actual commercial/residential/terrace use, appropriate code load and eligible seismic live share

gates.evidence_needed: Native mass source: element masses, explicit/additional masses, pattern coefficients and selfweight multiplier
gates.acceptance_test: Explicit mass-source settings with no duplicate dead/selfweight and versioned load-pattern provenance

gates.evidence_needed: Native ETABS story mass table and per-story member/slab/wall/dead/live attribution
gates.acceptance_test: Reproduce source Story1/Story2/Story3 mass with native units, original 6831.9109 kN W, quantify 715–772 kN trial gaps without mass plugs

gates.evidence_needed: Confirmed project site, hazard zone/site class, boreholes and applicable NBC105 edition
gates.acceptance_test: Document 2025 code parameter provenance and independent soil site category, not copied old soil class

gates.evidence_needed: Source-matched storeys, diaphragms, modal periods, eccentric actions, signed design cases and P-Delta
gates.acceptance_test: Resolve 0.618s vs 0.185s report statement and check signed drift/second-order on verified mass/geometry

gates.evidence_needed: Foundation F3 geotechnical borehole data, design SBC, water table, settlement limits and site bearing
gates.acceptance_test: Independent soil/bearing/settlement criteria confirm or reject printed SBC=160 kPa

gates.evidence_needed: Issued footing 2.1 m plan/thickness, column position, reinforcement, cover and actual effective depth
gates.acceptance_test: Resolve 423.46278 mm source worksheet against 394 mm historical assumed d and 450 mm overall D; verify detailed reinforcement

gates.evidence_needed: Signed F3 reactions, moments and combinations (service & ultimate), base and footing selfweight rules
gates.acceptance_test: Reconcile 571 kN vs 600 kN and the printed 194.22 kPa (uses 1.5×571/4.41, not 1.5×600/4.41)

gates.evidence_needed: Independently checked F3 redesign with actual geotech, load combinations, punching, one-way shear, flexure, anchorage and settlement
gates.acceptance_test: Separate engineer reviews and signs full design; until then original NOT SAFE IN ONE WAY SHEAR verdict remains
